groups.canonical_value: Prefer hotel rooms with both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior specifically uses the combination of an in-room coffee maker and refrigerator or mini-fridge as soft hotel-room amenity criteria; it is not semantically equivalent to a free-breakfast preference.

groups.canonical_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior specifically prefers included free breakfast and remains distinct from preferences concerning in-room beverage and refrigeration amenities.
